note: What is known about each model from its card and licence, separate from what this project measured. A row here is a claim with a source; a figure in results/ is a measurement with a host. Keeping them apart is what stops a vendor's number being read as ours.

kokoro-82m-v1-0-onnx.name: Kokoro-82M
kokoro-82m-v1-0-onnx.architectureNote: StyleTTS2 + ISTFTNet. One pass produces the whole utterance, so nothing is sequential across the audio.
kokoro-82m-v1-0-onnx.arenaNote: TTS Arena V2, read 2026-09-12. Highest-rated model on the board flagged open.

kitten-tts-nano-0-8.name: KittenTTS nano 0.8
kitten-tts-nano-0-8.architectureNote: StyleTTS2 + ISTFTNet + mini-ALBERT - the same family as the incumbent, at a fifth the size.
kitten-tts-nano-0-8.arenaNote: Not in TTS Arena V2. Won a blind listening test against the compact field at 71.2 percent.
kitten-tts-nano-0-8.warning: Do not use the int8 build - upstream reports open issues, and an independent port measured altered durations.

chatterbox.name: Chatterbox
chatterbox.architectureNote: Llama backbone plus S3Gen flow decoder. One forward pass per audio frame, which is what makes an AR model slow on a CPU.
chatterbox.arenaNote: TTS Arena V2, read 2026-09-12. Ranks ABOVE the incumbent, and the licence is more permissive.

inflect-micro-v2.name: Inflect-Micro-v2
inflect-micro-v2.arenaNote: Not in TTS Arena V2. Highest UTMOS22 of the compact set in its own published benchmark.
